messages:
PagerDuty: INCIDENT triggered: metering.alerts.token_count_drift (prod) — delta > 15% vs baseline. Priority: P2. Pager assigned: Oncall-SRE. PagerDuty: https://pd/redwood/incidents/INC-4729
Oncall-SRE: taking it — seeing alerts for billing-emitter-prod in the last 15m. starting triage.
Sara: ack. are customers affected or just internal counts? any overage flags sent?
BillingBot: 14:10 UTC - Overages flagged for tenant: acme-corp (estimate +22% tokens) — flag_pending=true.
Matt: oof. I can join. Sara, can you confirm which pipeline emitted the tokens? emitter-v2 or legacy-emitter?
Oncall-SRE: preliminary: emitter-v2 shard-3 shows token_count delta vs shadow counts. legacy looks normal.
Jing: adding logs — running quick query against metering-events within 14:00-14:12: 
```
SELECT emitter, sum(tokens) AS tokens FROM metering.events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2024-10-02T14:00:00Z' AND '2024-10-02T14:12:00Z'
GROUP BY emitter;
```
Jing: results: emitter-v2: 1,420,322 tokens, legacy: 1,200,101 tokens, shadow-verify: 1,180,900 tokens. emitter-v2 is high.
Sara: good call. Could be double-counting replay or dup writes in emitter-v2. Any recent deploys to emitter-v2?
Matt: deploy history shows a canary rolled to shard-3 at 13:58 UTC with a batching change (reduce window to 50ms). PR #842.
Oncall-SRE: running `kubectl logs` on emitter-v2 pod-3 for 13:55-14:05. see repeated ack loops and re-emit attempts: 
```
2024-10-02T13:59:01Z emitter-v2[pod-3] INFO ack failed for batch 0x7f9; retrying
2024-10-02T13:59:01Z emitter-v2[pod-3] INFO re-emit batch 0x7f9
```
Oncall-SRE: looks like transient ack failures to the broker caused re-emits and duplicates. broker-mq reported partial timeouts around 13:59.
Aly (support): is there a quick way to stop overage flags reaching customers? billing pipeline has a downstream job that flips flags when tokens > threshold.
Jing: yes — can pause the overage-flags job in airflow: `airflow pause overage_flags_prod` — but that pauses all flags; we should weigh customer impact vs false positives.
Sara: do it. we don't want false overage emails. Aly, coordinate comms if we pause.
Aly (support): pausing now. `airflow pause overage_flags_prod` — confirmation: job paused. sending note to CS to hold outbound alerts. :warning:
BillingBot: 14:16 UTC - overage_flags queue drained/prevented.
Matt: excellent. now mitigation: revert canary on shard-3 or patch emitter to dedupe on ack retry idempotency. which is faster?
Oncall-SRE: revert canary — quick k8s rollback on shard-3 to previous replicaset. planning `kubectl rollout undo deployment/emitter-v2 --to-revision=3` on shard-3 only.
Matt: I can do rollback. running it now.
PagerDuty: NOTE: on-call handoff scheduled in 15m to second-shift. Oncall-SRE: please post summary before handoff.
Matt: rollback triggered at 14:18 UTC. watching metrics.
Jing: shadow-verify counts real-time dropping to expected after rollback? monitoring delta.
Oncall-SRE: metrics show token delta reduced to <2% after 14:22. no new re-emits observed on pod logs.
Sara: great. keep an eye for backfill duplicates; we need to ensure downstream dedupe handles the window.
Aly (support): CS notified: holding outbound overage emails and flagged acme-corp for manual review. update sent to account team.
BillingBot: 14:25 UTC - manual override: acme-corp overage flag cleared (hold).
Matt: next steps: 1) revert PR #842 and add idempotency keys for re-emits 2) run a reconciliation job to detect and correct duplicate token entries 3) postmortem draft.
Oncall-SRE: created incident ticket INC-4729 with actions and timelines. saving logs and queries to incident runbook.
Jing: starting a reconciliation query to find duplicates using (tenant_id, batch_id, ts). running in offline job; estimate 30m.
Sara: for the postmortem please include timeline, root cause (ack retry + canary batching), customer impact (potential false overages flagged but emails prevented), mitigation steps (paused flags, rollback), and long-term fix (idempotency + broker timeouts tuning).
Matt: ping me if duplicates require credits/refunds — I'll coordinate with finance.
Oncall-SRE: final note before handoff: system stabilized at 14:22 UTC; overage flags paused at 14:16; rollback at 14:18; reconciliation job started 14:27. handing to second-shift in 10m.
Aly (support): leaving the thread for handoff — CS contact: emma@acme-corp.
PagerDuty: HANDOFF: Oncall-SRE -> Oncall-SRE-2 at 14:35 UTC. :handshake:
Oncall-SRE: ack handoff. leaving runbook and logs in INC-4729.
Sara: thanks team. please add any follow-ups here and link the postmortem when ready. :thumbsup:
